cases.case_label: MAST2-SVA retrotransposition event deleting FBN1 exons 7-9
cases.disease: Marfan-spectrum connective tissue disorder with mildly dilated aortic sinus (does not fulfil revised Ghent criteria)
cases.mechanism_detail: Chromosomal microarray showed a ~36.8 kb 15q21.1 deletion running from FBN1 intron 6 to intron 9 and removing exons 7-9. Breakpoint sequencing confirmed the deletion and revealed a concomitant retrotransposon insertion within the intron 6/intron 9 region, attributed to a MAST2-SVA element acting through repetitive sequences.
cases.quote: The intragenic deletion of exons 7-9 was likely the result of a retrotransposition event by a MAST2-SVA element mediated by repetitive sequences.
